blocks.text:
Tigre and the northern suburbs: a group excursion with an English-speaking guide, USD 100 per person. Visit San Isidro, then Tigre, around 40 km from central Buenos Aires, with a boat trip along the rivers and canals of the delta.

Montevideo, Uruguay: a full-day trip, USD 500 per person in a group with an English-speaking guide, or a private trip with an English-speaking guide for at least two travellers at USD 850 per person. Transfer to the port and take a ferry across the Río de la Plata. The guided drive takes in the port, Independence Square, the city centre, Old Town and the Cathedral. There is free time before the return ferry and transfer to your hotel. Ferry tickets are included.

Fiesta Gaucha: a full-day excursion of approximately eight hours, with an English-speaking guide in a group, USD 350 per person. The ranch is about 80 km from the city. Discover gaucho traditions, horsemanship, lassos and boleadoras. A traditional Argentine lunch is included.
